tag: 節慶期間退換貨規定說明會

level.why: 店務會議含轉折與規定，需用同義換句判斷聽眾與說話意圖。

script.t: Thanks for staying after closing, everyone, because I need to go over our holiday plans.
script.zh: 謝謝大家打烊後留下來，因為我需要說明我們的節慶期間計畫。

script.t: First, the store will open at seven a.m. instead of nine on the Friday after Thanksgiving.
script.zh: 第一，感恩節後的那個週五，本店將在上午七點開門，而不是九點。

script.t: We expected a quiet morning, but last year the line reached the parking lot by eight.
script.zh: 我們原本預期早上會很安靜，但去年八點時排隊人龍就排到停車場了。

script.t: So each cashier will work with a helper to keep the lines moving.
script.zh: 所以每位收銀員都會搭配一位助手，讓隊伍保持前進。

script.t: Second, the return period for gifts will be extended to forty-five days, not thirty.
script.zh: 第二，禮品的退貨期限將延長為四十五天，而不是三十天。

script.t: However, items without a receipt can only be exchanged for store credit.
script.zh: 不過，沒有收據的商品只能換成店內購物金。

script.t: Please do not promise anything outside this policy, even if a customer gets upset.
script.zh: 即使顧客不高興，也請不要承諾超出這項規定的事。

script.t: If a customer insists, call a manager to the front desk.
script.zh: 如果顧客堅持，請叫經理到服務台。

script.t: Please check the new schedule on the staff board before you leave tonight.
script.zh: 離開前請先看員工布告欄上的新班表。

script.t: Thanks again, and let's make this our best season yet.
script.zh: 再次感謝大家，讓我們讓這季成為最好的一季。

q.t: Who is the speaker most likely addressing?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是在對誰說話？

choices.why: 正解：打烊後的店務說明，提到收銀員與班表。
顧客只是員工服務的對象。
沒有提到送貨。
沒有提到保全工作。

q.t: How long will customers have to return gifts?
q.zh: 顧客有多久時間可以退回禮品？

choices.why: 正解：forty-five days → 一個半月。
三十天是舊的期限。
沒有提到一週。
期限是以天數計算。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "Please do not promise anything outside this policy, even if a customer gets upset."?
q.zh: 說話者說「Please do not promise anything outside this policy, even if a customer gets upset.」是暗示什麼？

choices.t: Employees should follow the official return rules.
choices.zh: 員工應遵守正式的退貨規定。
choices.why: 正解：不要承諾規定之外的事。

choices.t: Employees may offer longer returns to upset customers.
choices.zh: 員工可以給不高興的顧客更長的退貨期。
choices.why: 與說話者要求相反。

choices.t: Customers should call a manager first.
choices.why: 叫經理是顧客堅持時才做的事。

choices.t: The return period will end soon.
choices.why: 期限是延長，不是即將結束。

tag: 雜貨店週末營業時間調整報導

level.why: 新聞報導需結合營業時間表與獨白更正，並推論活動影響。

script.t: In consumer news today, Greenfield Market, the city's largest grocery store, has announced changes to its weekend schedule.
script.zh: 今天的消費新聞，全市最大的雜貨店 Greenfield Market 宣布調整週末營業時間。

script.t: The store is usually open until eight p.m. on Saturdays, but it will close at five this week.
script.zh: 該店週六通常營業到晚上八點，但本週將在五點關門。

script.t: Managers say the nearby Harvest Street Festival will block most roads in the afternoon.
script.zh: 經理表示，附近的 Harvest Street 慶典下午會封閉大部分道路。

script.t: They expect fewer shoppers than usual, and many employees will be volunteering at the festival.
script.zh: 他們預期顧客會比平常少，而且許多員工將到慶典當志工。

script.t: Sunday hours will not change, so customers can still shop from ten to six.
script.zh: 週日時間不變，所以顧客仍可在十點到六點購物。

script.t: However, the in-store bakery will be closed all day Saturday because of a staff shortage.
script.zh: 不過，店內麵包坊週六整天關閉，因為人手不足。

script.t: To help shoppers, the store will let customers order online and pick up groceries at the side entrance.
script.zh: 為了幫助顧客，店家讓顧客線上訂購後，到側門領取雜貨。

script.t: Online orders must be placed before noon on Friday.
script.zh: 線上訂單必須在週五中午前下單。

script.t: That is the latest from the business desk. I am Julia Reyes, reporting.
script.zh: 以上是商業新聞組的最新消息，我是 Julia Reyes 為您報導。

q.t: What is the report mainly about?
q.zh: 這則報導主要在談什麼？

choices.t: A change to a store's weekend hours
choices.zh: 商店週末營業時間的更動
choices.why: 正解：announced changes to its weekend schedule。

choices.t: The opening of a street festival
choices.why: 慶典只是調整的原因。
沒有提到價格。

choices.t: The opening of a new bakery
choices.why: 麵包坊只是週六暫停營業。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How long will Greenfield Market be open on Saturday?
q.zh: 請看圖表。Greenfield Market 週六將營業多久？

choices.why: 正解：圖表顯示九點開門，獨白更正為五點關門，共八小時。
九點到晚上八點是原本的十一小時。
九是開門時間，不是營業時數。
五是關門時間，不是營業時數。

q.t: What is implied about the Harvest Street Festival?
q.zh: 關於 Harvest Street 慶典暗示了什麼？

choices.t: It will make travel to the store harder.
choices.zh: 它會讓前往商店更困難。
choices.why: 正解：道路下午會被封閉，顧客預計減少。

choices.t: It will take place inside the store.
choices.why: 慶典在附近街道舉行。
只說明本週六下午封路。

choices.t: It is organized by Greenfield Market.
choices.zh: 它由 Greenfield Market 主辦。
choices.why: 員工只是去當志工。

tag: 冬季外套購物建議節目

level.why: 廣播節目提供購物建議，含反直覺說法與轉折，需推論並預測後續節目。

script.t: Welcome back to Smart Shopper Hour, the show that helps your money go further.
script.zh: 歡迎回到《Smart Shopper Hour》，這個讓您錢花得更值得的節目。

script.t: Today's tip is about buying winter coats, and many people make the same mistake.
script.zh: 今天的小撇步是關於買冬季外套，而很多人都犯同樣的錯。

script.t: They wait until December, thinking prices will drop even lower.
script.zh: 他們等到十二月，以為價格會再降更多。

script.t: In fact, most stores offer their best coat prices in late October, while December selection is limited.
script.zh: 事實上，多數商店在十月底提供最好的外套價格，而十二月可選擇的款式有限。

script.t: By December, popular sizes are often sold out, so the savings do not matter.
script.zh: 到了十二月，熱門尺寸常常已經售完，省下的錢也就沒有意義。

script.t: My advice is to compare at least three stores before you buy.
script.zh: 我的建議是購買前至少比較三家商店。

script.t: Also check the return policy, because some stores charge a fee if you send an item back.
script.zh: 也要確認退貨規定，因為有些商店在您退貨時會收費。

script.t: Finally, sign up for store emails, but create a separate address so your main inbox does not fill up.
script.zh: 最後，請訂閱商店電子報，但要另外建立一個信箱，以免主要信箱被塞滿。

script.t: That is all the time we have today, and tomorrow we will talk about buying electronics online.
script.zh: 今天的時間就到這裡，明天我們將談談網購電子產品。

script.t: Thanks for listening, and happy shopping!
script.zh: 感謝收聽，祝購物愉快！

q.t: When do most stores offer the best coat prices?
q.zh: 多數商店何時提供最好的外套價格？

choices.why: 正解：late October。
十二月是多數人誤以為最便宜的時候。
沒有提到一月。
沒有提到假日後的折扣。

q.t: What can be inferred about shoppers who wait until December?
q.zh: 關於等到十二月才買的顧客，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: They may have fewer sizes to choose from.
choices.zh: 他們可選的尺寸可能比較少。
choices.why: 正解：熱門尺寸常常已售完。

choices.t: They will pay less than October shoppers.
choices.zh: 他們會比十月買的人付得少。
choices.why: 與說話者的說法相反。

choices.t: They can return items for free.
choices.why: 有些商店退貨要收費。

choices.zh: 他們會最先收到電子報。
choices.why: 電子報是另一項建議。

q.t: What will the speaker discuss tomorrow?

choices.t: Shopping for devices on the internet
choices.zh: 在網路上購買電子產品
choices.why: 正解：buying electronics online。
這是今天的主題。
這只是今天的小建議之一。
退貨費用只是今天提到的提醒。
